summary: The StudentPRPreferenceMessage handles student messages with support for alternate language fields.
purpose: To manage student messages, including the ability to use alternate language messages.

fields.name: StudentMessage
fields.description: The message for the student in the primary language.

fields.name: StudentMessageAlt
fields.description: The alternate language message for the student.

workflows.name: Retrieving Student Messages
steps: Load messages for a student using the stored procedure 'StudentPRPReferenceMessagesAdd'.
Localize the message based on session language settings.

workflows.name: Deleting a Student Message
steps: Call the stored procedure 'StudentPRPReferenceMessagesDelete' with the message ID.

conditions: If the session is set to use alternate language fields, the alternate language message is used.
system_behavior: Handles CRUD operations for student messages while supporting localization.
